html:
Born in an underground civilisation, you dream of the surface—a mythical, unknown world deemed taboo. Pursue your ambitions inspired by ancient relics, and make your way through the various underground layers that stand between you and your dream.

Sunward is a third-person platformer and exploration game developed by students at Objectif 3D. Explore and climb through underground ecosystems, uncover secrets buried in time, and reach the legendary surface.

About this game :

  • Third-person camera

  • Climbing and rope swinging

  • Interactions with the environment

  • 2 fully hand-crafted environments

  • Collection of secret items

  • Bioluminescent environment
